voice: Short, clear, friendly and locally grounded. Name the printed product.
Use the exact verified configuration when stating a price. A custom-options or design-help piece does not need a price.
Keep one purchase question per piece. Avoid generic design lectures and unsupported customer stories.

visualLanes.instructions: Large tactile sticker/product hero, saturated cobalt campaign field and cream headline. Restrained props and generous breathing room. Illustrative design example, no logo overlay.
Quiet ivory composition, top-down sticker sizing study. Use honest dimension guides; do not invent a measurement or material test. Avoid the packaging-box hero composition.
Dark editorial type study showing how a sticker message can be arranged clearly. Original illustrative artwork, not an invented client commission.
Clean step-by-step choice diagram. Label it as a guide, not a screenshot of the live configurator.
Preserve an authentic, cleared product photograph and its actual context. Minimal intervention; do not invent customer endorsement.

contactPanels.instructions: Clear dark base panel: action and readable website first, pickup address next, phone prominent. Keep text off the printed artwork.
Light editorial margin with the same clear website, pickup address and phone hierarchy. Keep it spacious; do not stamp the hero footer onto this layout.
Use genuine negative space for the action, website, pickup address and phone. Keep the entire contact block readable at phone size.
